name: FREST
description:
About This Game

When Riley stumbles across a mysterious portal in her backyard, she’s transported to Nekojima—a mystical world teetering on the edge of collapse. Inhabited by feline-like beings called Cates. Three tyrannical World Lords now rule the once peaceful land. Guided by a strange talking frog named Ben, Riley must fight to restore balance, uncover the truth, and find a way back home.

Master your moves and push your limits!

  • Master your moveset and learn new tools to overcome increasingly difficult obstacles.

  • Replay levels against a timer, or go up against new and more challenging areas once you've beaten a level!

Reconnect a fractured world.

  • Traverse across three different provinces to free the trapped cates, and build a new home.

  • Uncover hidden pages that slowly reveal the secrets of a world lost to time.
short_desc: Unravel a forgotten world. Discover your power. Decide its fate. When Riley stumbles across a mysterious portal in her backyard, she’s transported to Nekojima—a mystical world teetering on the edge of collapse.
